title: Dance Impressions
specs: Annual Winter Review in December and Spring Recital in May
Non-refundable annual registration fee of $35 per student or $55 per family due upon registration
Tuition based on dance year September through May, divided into equal monthly payments
No credit for absences or vacations; payment expected even if student misses class
Written notification required before the 15th of preceding month to withdraw or transfer classes
includes: Basic holiday attire included in Winter Showcase fee
Spring Recital costume includes tights and all accessories
Digital recording of Spring Recital and t-shirt(s) included in family fee
blurb: Guests register for dance classes that run from September through May. Classes are organized by dance genre and time, with options to join a waiting list if full. The studio holds a Winter Review in December and a Spring Recital in May, with associated fees for participation.
extraNote: All tuition is non-refundable · Late fee of $5 if tuition not paid by the 5th of the month · $15 fee for all returned checks; no resubmission to bank thereafter · Students more than 30 days past due cannot participate in activities or classes · No refunds of registration fee at any time · September through May
